name: QA 2114
description:
PCP QA Test No. 2114



Check for memory leaks on the error paths of the derived metrics parser,

and in the teardown of a derived metric holding a compiled regex.



Companion test qa/2113 checks the diagnostics from the same expressions.



Note the expressions are deliberately bundled into one config file, and

the last one is deliberately harmless.  The parser keeps its most recent

allocations in file-scope statics (np, specmeta) and in bison's

derive_lval, so the last thing a failed parse leaks is still reachable

at exit and valgrind reports it as "still reachable", not "definitely

lost".  It only becomes definitely lost once a later parse overwrites

those pointers ... so every expression here needs another one after it,

and one expression per run would prove nothing.
